examples.limitations: Fixture confirmation does not establish a GitHub App-user effect. Existing-action and prepared recovery cases cover original intent and explicit recovery without submitting a comment. The prepared recovery case proves local confirmation visibility only; it does not prove publication. Live publication requires an explicit selected issue and source write opt-in.
